Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q2 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MRK.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $0.55 per share.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 83 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q2 2019.
We generated $5.1 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Revenue guidance of $20.9 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Thank you for the question. We delivered record revenue of $20.9 billion this quarter, representing 5% year-over-year growth.
Second question - Analyst:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Revenue guidance of $20.9 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
